description: Implementation of StringOutputBuffer class for managing string data with file I/O operations, including appending data, comparing contents with files, and writing data to files.

classes.name: StringOutputBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a buffer of strings with capabilities to append data, compare with files, and write to files.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns the concatenated string contents of the buffer.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer from a character pointer and length.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer from a std::string_view.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a single character to the buffer.

methods.name: ContentsEqual
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contents are equal to the contents of a specified file.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes the buffer contents to a specified file, creating directories if necessary.

methods.name: WriteToFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes the buffer to a file only if the contents differ from the existing file.
